apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.45.5 - UPDATE NOW INSTALLS AGAIN (setup 1.28.61)
  - Help → Update now did not install on some computers: the program closed and nothing happened (an antivirus program stopped the hidden PowerShell that does the update). It is now a plain batch file (update.cmd), and the program first checks that it started; if it did not, it offers to open the setup itself (Yes, Next, Install; Finish opens the program again). The log is in %TEMP%\BeaconUpdate\update.log.
  - Install this version by hand once (from the download page).
